list.text: Cidade Fallabor.\n"Um pequena cidade, que cultiva solidariedade."

then.text: \f[face_namo_girl]\rMy name is \v[76]!
\f[face_namo_angry_girl]\rHey!
\f[face_namo_angry_girl]\rWait, you're still together?
\f[face_namo_angry_girl]\r...Huh. You don't even look good together.
\f[face_namo_girl]\rAnyway, I'm looking for someone to team up with for the Doubles Tournament.
\f[face_namo_girl]\rAnd I would like \v[77] to accompany me.
\f[face_namo_girl]\rLet's do this: if I win a battle against you, he'll be my partner in the tournament!

lines: EndSpeech: Isso não aconteceu de verdade!
EndSpeech: Isso não aconteceu de verdade!
EndSpeech: iIsso não aconteceu de verdade!

else.text: \f[face_namo_angry_boy]\bHey!
\f[face_namo_angry_boy]\bWait, you're still together?
\f[face_namo_angry_boy]\bI don't know what that beautiful girl saw in a fool like you!
\f[face_namo_angry_boy]\bIt's obvious that I'm better than you!
\f[face_namo_angry_boy]\bAnyway, I'm looking for someone to team up with for the Doubles Tournament.
\f[face_namo_boy]\bAnd I would like \v[77] to accompany me.
\f[face_namo_boy]\bLet's do this: if I win a battle against you, he'll be my partner in the tournament!

lines: EndSpeech: Isso não aconteceu de verdade!
EndSpeech: Isso não aconteceu de verdade!
EndSpeech: iIsso não aconteceu de verdade!

then.text: \f[face_namo_cry_girl]\rWhat a disaster! bububu...
\f[face_namo_cry_girl]\rIt won't stay like this for long... *sniff*
\f[face_namo_cry_girl]\rI'm going to train harder and prove that I'm better than you!
\f[face_namo_cry_girl]\rUntil later \v[77]!

else.text: \f[face_namo_cry_boy]\bWhat a disaster! bububu...
\f[face_namo_cry_boy]\bIt won't stay like this for long... *sniff*
\f[face_namo_cry_boy]\bI'm going to train harder and prove that I'm better than you!
\f[face_namo_cry_boy]\bUntil later \v[76]!

then.text: \f[face_namo_girl]\rYes! I knew I would win!
\f[face_namo_girl]\rNow that I've proven I'm the best, \v[76] you have to join me in the Slateport Doubles Tournament!
\f[face_namo_admiring_girl]\rWe'll be the cutest couple!
\f[face_namo_girl]\r...
\f[face_namo_angry_girl]\rWhat do you mean, no?!
\f[face_namo_cry_girl]\rDo you prefer hanging out with that uggly girl?!
\f[face_namo_cry_girl]\rI can't believe that!
\f[face_namo_cry_girl]\rThis won't end here; I'll still show you all my qualities!
\f[face_namo_cry_girl]\rGet ready to fall in love with me...
\f[face_namo_cry_girl]\rBuááááá!

else.text: \f[face_namo_boy]\bYes! I knew I would win!
\f[face_namo_boy]\bNow that I've proven I'm the best, \v[76] you have to join me in the Slateport Doubles Tournament!
\f[face_namo_admiring_boy]\bWe'll make a great couple!
\f[face_namo_boy]\b...
\f[face_namo_angry_boy]\bWhat do you mean, no?!
\f[face_namo_cry_boy]\bDo you prefer hanging out with that loser?!
\f[face_namo_cry_boy]\bI can't believe that!
\f[face_namo_cry_boy]\bI will still show you all my qualities, lovely maiden!
\f[face_namo_cry_boy]\bGet ready to fall in love with me...
\f[face_namo_cry_boy]\bBuááááá!

list.text: Torneio de Duplas de Fallabor\n"O mais disputado torneio da região"
\bVocê já enfrentou Flannery, a líder do Ginásio de Lavaridge?
\bO avô da garota é famoso.\nEle era membro da Elite dos Quatro há algum tempo.
\bNão é surpresa ver que Flannery é uma ótima treinadora.
\bAlgo está acontecendo, e eu não gosto disso...
\bEstou vendo pessoas estranhas ao redor da cidade.
\rOlhe! Dê uma olhada!\nEsse é meu precioso Azurill.
\rEle é liso, suave e felpudo também!
